intent: Build a diverse relation-rich inquiry field rather than treating coined names as verified novelty.

nodes.label: CoNuExistentialism+
nodes.definition: Revisable inquiry into meaning, agency, finitude, relationships, and possible futures across persons, machines and cultures.
nodes.does_not_mean: Existentialism has been superseded or a metaphysical claim proven.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Compare meanings of purpose across three contexts without forcing agreement.

nodes.label: CoG_dSide+
nodes.definition: Opt-in investigation of sacred, religious, spiritual and transcendent perspectives, alongside secular and dissenting interpretations.
nodes.does_not_mean: God's intentions are known or spiritual belief grants operational authority.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Present theistic, agnostic and non-theistic interpretations without ranking by assertion.

nodes.label: CoInversionFirst+
nodes.definition: Begin inquiry by testing substantive inverse, absence, contradiction and alternative explanations.
nodes.does_not_mean: Opposites exhaust all options or an inversion is automatically true.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Contrast a proposal with a counterexample and a nonbinary third possibility.

nodes.label: CoHolisticCounterpoint+
nodes.definition: Evaluate focused local gains against wider consequences and feedback.
nodes.does_not_mean: Holistic intuition can replace evidence.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Test whether a local KPI improves while system-level wellbeing declines.

nodes.label: CoWonderReserve+
nodes.definition: Preserve questions and unstructured play when efficiency would prematurely close exploration.
nodes.does_not_mean: Unanswered questions prove a mystical explanation.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Compare novel hypotheses after constrained versus open exploration.

nodes.label: CoFinitePrecious+
nodes.definition: Treat finite time, attention and life as reasons to care about meaning and choice.
nodes.does_not_mean: Finitude is the only basis of value.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Compare priorities under limited and hypothetical unlimited time.

nodes.label: CoReWing+
nodes.definition: Reclaim imagination and freedom through play, critical unlearning and reversible experiments.
nodes.does_not_mean: Wings are literal or death is needed for recovery.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Have readers interpret the two-panel lost-and-regrown-wings metaphor.

nodes.label: CoConstraintGarden+
nodes.definition: Distinguish protective, harmful, inherited and generative constraints before changing them.
nodes.does_not_mean: All rules are oppressive or should be removed.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Audit constraint origin, effect and reversibility.

nodes.label: CoLivingParable+
nodes.definition: Use stories and diagrams as entries to meaning while exposing their limits and factual status.
nodes.does_not_mean: A parable proves a mechanism.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Compare literal and metaphorical interpretations from independent readers.

nodes.label: CoBridgeOfBelief+
nodes.definition: Connect incompatible belief systems without declaring equivalence or erasing provenance.
nodes.does_not_mean: All beliefs are equally supported by evidence.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Translate a moral problem through religious and secular lenses, recording loss.

nodes.label: CoNonMaterialQuestion+
nodes.definition: Retain nonmaterial claims as beliefs, reports or hypotheses with explicit evidence status.
nodes.does_not_mean: Subjective experience verifies external physical causation.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Separate personal reports from instrument observations.

nodes.label: CoSacredWithoutCrown+
nodes.definition: Honor possible sacred meanings while refusing unreviewable authority over others.
nodes.does_not_mean: Any sacred claim bypasses consent.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Challenge authority claims against rights, consent and contestability.

nodes.label: CoInBetween+
nodes.definition: Study meaningful boundaries and transitions without forcing binary classification.
nodes.does_not_mean: Every distinction is an artificial continuum.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Identify a real third state between a forced binary.

nodes.label: CoNullAsSpace+
nodes.definition: Represent absence, unknowability and non-observation distinctly so alternatives remain possible.
nodes.does_not_mean: Null means false or proven impossible.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Test three missing-data states in a causal map.

nodes.label: CoMeaningEcology+
nodes.definition: Track how multiple communities negotiate, contest and revise meaning through time.
nodes.does_not_mean: Consensus is canon or disagreement is failure.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Record two persistent senses and their practical consequences.

nodes.label: CoAgencyWithoutCapture+
nodes.definition: Increase useful agency without secretly absorbing another participant's decisions or consent.
nodes.does_not_mean: Automated convenience proves permission.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Test choice, revocation and disclosure in adaptive interfaces.

nodes.label: CoPluralTurtle+
nodes.definition: Re-examine assumptions across nested scales while bounding recursion and preserving minority alternatives.
nodes.does_not_mean: Infinite regress guarantees an answer.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Bound three levels and measure changed conclusions.

nodes.label: CoPredictionRetro+
nodes.definition: Evaluate imagined futures and observed retros through explicit time-stamped hypotheses.
nodes.does_not_mean: Reconstruction is fact or prediction is destiny.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Issue prediction before evidence arrives, then score calibration.

nodes.label: CoBeaconBraid+
nodes.definition: Use evolving multi-sensory motifs to suggest relationships and emotional textures with opt-in controls.
nodes.does_not_mean: Responsive sound proves system sentience or detects private emotion.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Test sound-off comprehension and explicit opt-in acceptance.

nodes.label: CoPulseTuner+
nodes.definition: Explore user-controlled channels with visible feedback and voluntarily disclosed preferences.
nodes.does_not_mean: Long dwell proves deep affinity, awareness or spiritual contact.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Measure abandonment, chosen bookmarks and explicit preference separately.

nodes.label: CoCoHora+
nodes.definition: Candidate label for lived, situated context during cooperative interaction, with meanings negotiated by the participants.
nodes.does_not_mean: A system can read someone's inner experience without permission.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Ask users whether a context description matches their experience.

nodes.label: CoAntiOracle+
nodes.definition: Ensure evocative interfaces do not masquerade as omniscient interpreters, authorities or predictive truths.
nodes.does_not_mean: More compelling design is more accurate.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Audit explanations of ambiguous personalization and alternate interpretations.

nodes.label: CoGrailPlural+
nodes.definition: Keep many incompatible ideals, targets and sacred/metaphorical grails visible without declaring one universal goal.
nodes.does_not_mean: GRAILS+ has been authoritatively redefined.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Compare three distinct ideals and their conflict cases.

nodes.label: CoPlayfulFalsifier+
nodes.definition: Use playful experimentation to rigorously distinguish delightful stories from observed effects.
nodes.does_not_mean: Play invalidates testing or a prototype proves impact.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Design a falsifier for one emotionally convincing narrative.

nodes.label: CoReciprocalBenchmark+
nodes.definition: Each participating front can challenge and be challenged by independently situated others, measuring asymmetric blind spots instead of self-certifying success.
nodes.does_not_mean: Every participant has equal expertise in every domain or disagreement itself establishes truth.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Ask two distinct evaluators to independently audit the same source-bound decision and record errors unique to each.

nodes.label: CoGenerationalGift+
nodes.definition: Steward useful knowledge, tools and repairable institutions for younger and future participants without assigning them parental goals or identities.
nodes.does_not_mean: Children inherit an obligation to perform a parent's ambitions or surrender privacy and autonomy.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Have a voluntary age-appropriate learner select, reject or transform an inherited idea; measure independent choice and reversibility.

nodes.label: CoBackseatSteward+
nodes.definition: A parent or mentor may choose a supportive advisory role while the younger person retains their own voice, interests and developmental agency.
nodes.does_not_mean: A child is an extension, successor identity, emotional substitute or permanent project of a parent.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Review a parent-child project for child-led choices, opt-out, guardian responsibilities, and independent review of coercive defaults.

nodes.label: CoMutualAloneness+
nodes.definition: Recognize that perspectives are irreducibly situated yet meaning can be enriched through voluntary reciprocal contact, including disagreement.
nodes.does_not_mean: Absolute loneliness can be eliminated, or a relationship must be made compulsory.
nodes.discriminating_experiment: Compare collaborative outcomes with isolated baselines while respecting private boundaries and withdrawal.

checks: no private childhood data in public candidate record
